findings.reason: the plan should specify one function taking the pulse (and figure name), so §3 adds a call rather than a per-pulse copy of the whole body, which is exactly the surface-without-depth shape this item exists to catch.
findings.text: §3 draws E101031 "exactly as §1 draws E101154's" by editing the same script whose module constants `SHOT`/`FIGURE` (`:32-33`) and `PULSE_DIR`/`_read_pulse_ids` (`:34-41`) are fixed to E101154 and whose `_main()` takes no pulse, yet the design names no shared parameterized entry point, so the second figure duplicates the open→`extract_signal_traces`→`time_trace_figure_mpl`→`render_to_bytes` path rather than hiding it behind one call taking a pulse

findings.reason: §3 must name `resolve_settings` as the source of `pulse_path`'s `out_root` argument, or the script re-forks the path resolution the sibling plan exists to consolidate, and §3's own claim to "never name a path itself" is unmet.
findings.text: §3 routes the pulse-file name to `pulse_path` but never names the owner of the pulse root: the landed script resolves it from `imas_ambix/data/paths.py:45` (`JT60SA_ROOT`), while facility-mint §8 introduces `imas_alambic/settings.py` `resolve_settings` (`IMAS_ALAMBIC_IDS_ROOT`, `docs/plans/jt60sa-facility-mint.html:201`) as the sole root resolver and retires the machine-named store-root key — so §3 as written risks a second root reader beside the settings owner

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — §3 adds a second pulse by editing the one script whose pulse, figure name and directory are fixed to E101154 and whose entry point takes no pulse, without naming a shared parameterized drawing path; the read→extract→render step is at risk of being copied per pulse instead of hidden behind one call.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan routes the pulse-file *name* to `pulse_path` but leaves the pulse *root's* resolution unnamed, so §3 risks a second reader of the root beside the settings owner the sibling plan introduces.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0 (read 2026-10-07T04:11:23Z); the plan adds no public definition, CLI option, MCP view or refusal family. §3's only named new mechanism, `pulse_path`, is owned and counted by jt60sa-facility-mint §8, and this plan reuses it rather than adding it.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan cites the mechanisms it extends and they exist: imas-ink's `extract_signal_traces` (`imas_ink/extract.py:815`) for both §1's `coil/current` + `ip` and §2's `flux_loop/flux`, and facility-mint §8's `pulse_path` (`docs/plans/jt60sa-facility-mint.html:243`) as the layout owner; geometry-and-signal-figures §3 is recorded as superseded rather than paralleled. It proposes no new drawing machinery.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the script is a driver over imas-ink's public API in a separate package (`extract_signal_traces`, `time_trace_figure_mpl`, `render_to_bytes`); it re-implements nothing imas-ink owns, and its one non-delegated responsibility (opening the pulse IDS) is being routed to `pulse_path`.
